name: How long does a typical window repair take for a non-closing window?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical window repair take for a non-closing window?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a window repair for a non-closing window depends entirely on the complexity of the issue. Simple fixes, such as clearing debris from tracks, lubricating parts, or tightening a loose screw, might only take 30 minutes to an hour. Replacing a broken balance or latch could take 1-3 hours, depending on the window type and accessibility. More extensive repairs involving frame adjustments or multiple component replacements might require a half-day or even longer, potentially needing a second visit if special parts need to be ordered. Your contractor can provide an accurate time estimate after diagnosis.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from 30 minutes for simple fixes to several hours or a half-day for complex issues, depending on the problem and parts needed.
